description: Stanford provides Claude for Education to faculty, students, postdocs, and staff through a campus pilot through August 2027.
howToObtain: Submit an activation request form and sign in via Stanford SSO.
costToUser: Free pilot access; higher tiers may be paid.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: All Stanford faculty, students, postdocs, and staff with a SUNet ID have free access to these tools; affiliates have a paid option as well. For heavier workloads, discounted Pro/Premium tiers of all three tools remain available for purchase on a Stanford PTA or through a student account.

Claude for Education bundles Claude Chat, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork for teaching, learning, research, and administrative work, all within a university-managed environment built for academic integrity and data protection. Like ChatGPT Edu, it requires a quick request form on the Claude for Education service page.
Low Risk Moderate Risk High Risk with no PHI
PHI processing is not covered under this approval.

description: Stanford provides Google Gemini Enterprise to faculty, students, postdocs, and staff through a campus pilot through August 2027.
howToObtain: First sign in to the Gemini Enterprise homepage with your SUNet ID; no request form required.
costToUser: Free pilot access; higher tiers may be paid.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: All Stanford faculty, students, postdocs, and staff with a SUNet ID have free access to these tools; affiliates have a paid option as well. For heavier workloads, discounted Pro/Premium tiers of all three tools remain available for purchase on a Stanford PTA or through a student account.

Gemini Enterprise activates automatically the first time you sign in with your SUNet ID through the Gemini Enterprise homepage; no request form is needed. It includes Gemini Notebook Enterprise (formerly NotebookLM Enterprise) for literature reviews, course prep, and grant writing. Gemini Enterprise also connects to Google Drive, OneDrive, Slack, and Microsoft 365.
